subject: Hosted API pricing proposal & Paxora commit options
messages:
From: Emma White <emma.white@paxora.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@paxora.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood hosted pricing for 200M mo tokens - initial ask

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the latency numbers looked promising for our user flows. We're running a cost exercise comparing Redwood Hosted vs OpenAI/Anthropic hosted endpoints for our generative analytics feature.

High level: Paxora expects ~200M generation tokens / month initially, scaling to 500M over 6 months if performance and costs align. Procurement asked me to get:
- A usage-based per-token price with clear breakpoints for commit tiers (monthly or annual)
- Any one-time migration credits or onboarding concessions
- SLA language for latency percentiles and outage credits

OpenAI and Anthropic have both given us offers with effective blended per-token rates and an explicit cloud exit credit if we commit 12 months. Can Redwood match on economics or offer a structure that makes switching low-risk?

Can you share a proposal and a mutual action plan (timelines + POC milestones)? We need something to present to Legal/Procurement by next Tuesday 1/13.

Best,
Emma
Emma White
Head of Product
Paxora
[Attachment: Paxora_usage_estimates.csv (CSV, 24KB)]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Jan 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood hosted pricing for 200M mo tokens - initial ask

Hi Emma — thanks for the details and the CSV. I pulled together an initial commercial proposal and an outline MAP so you have something concrete for Procurement/Legal. See the two attachments and the short summary below.

Summary (first pass):
- Commit tiers (monthly billable usage):
  - 0–50M tokens: $0.0038 / token (on-demand)
  - 50M–250M tokens: $0.0026 / token (tier rate with 6 month commit)
  - 250M+ tokens: $0.0019 / token (12 month committed tier)
- Migration credit: $120k one-time credit spread over first 3 invoices for 12-month commit (to offset cloud exit costs)
- Trial POC: 30-day POC (up to 20M tokens) at no charge to validate latency and output quality; we will provide a dedicated SRE channel for the POC
- SLA: 99.95% uptime for hosted endpoint; latency SLO targets in the attached SLA doc; financial credits for SLA misses in term sheet

Notes:
- The blended per-token equivalent at 200M/mo under the 6-month commit structure is ~ $0.0025/token after the migration credit is amortized — we can walk through the math in a quick call.
- We are willing to include a 60-day price protection clause for 12-month commit to match any written competitor economic terms presented prior to contract signing.

Attachments: MAP_Paxora_Q1.pdf (mutual action plan), term-sheet-redwood-v2.docx (commercial + SLA).

If that looks in the ballpark, I'll loop in Ben (discount approval) and Finance to convert to a redline-ready contract. Can you confirm Paxora's preferred billing cadence (monthly vs. quarterly) and whether Legal needs any specific regulatory language?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_Paxora_Q1.pdf (PDF, 450KB)] [Attachment: term-sheet-redwood-v2.docx (DOCX, 120KB)]

From: Emma White <emma.white@paxora.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@paxora.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jan 2026 14:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood hosted pricing for 200M mo tokens - initial ask

Monica — thanks for the quick proposal and MAP. A few procurement constraints and competitor points before we loop legal:

- Procurement prefers monthly invoicing but can do quarterly if necessary for committed tiers.
- OpenAI has offered us a 12-month commit with a $150k migration credit and a conditional discounted rate that steps down at 300M tokens.
- Anthropic provided a creative bundling that includes a free evaluation window + a 3-month credit if we hit specified SLA targets.

Net ask: if Redwood can either (A) match the $150k migration credit or (B) increase the price-protection window to 120 days and add a clear cloud-exit credit for early termination, Procurement will prioritize Redwood for the vendor shortlist.

Also — Legal has two asks: confirmation that customer data will not be used to train models, and an editable SLA exhibit.

Would you like Procurement and Legal to join a 30-min call next week to finalize terms? We are aiming to decide by 1/20.

Best,
Emma

Team — forwarding Paxora's counter (see below). Procurement is asking us to either match the $150k migration credit or extend price-protection and provide a cloud-exit credit. They also want explicit confirmation about data usage.

My read: Paxora is a reasonable logo and the ARR here looks like mid-six figures in year 1 if they ramp. I recommend the following concession package to win the deal:
- Offer $140k migration credit (split: $80k signing credit + $60k amortized over 4 invoices) if they sign a 12-month committed tier at 250M/mo floor.
- 120-day price protection window (from LOI date).
- Cloud-exit credit: up to $50k refundable credit if they migrate off Redwood within the first 12 months (pro-rated based on tokens consumed).
- Legal/sales to confirm standard data protection clause: no customer data used for model training; can provide a DPA and editable SLA exhibit.

Requesting approval to present this package to Paxora. Ben — need signoff on $140k credit (finance-backed). Lauren/Aditya — please draft the redline-ready SLA exhibit and DPA so we can share with Legal.

Thanks,
Monica
